Definition: Malluk, the name of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Malluch or Melicu = "counsellor"; 1) a Merarite Levite, son of Hashabiah; 2) a descendant of Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 3) a descendant of Harim who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 4) a priest who signed the covenant with Nehemiah; 5) one of the leaders of the people who signed the covenant with Nehemiah; 6) a priest who returned from exile with Zerubbabel
